scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:app
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:app
scripts.format: npm run format:api && npm run format:app
scripts.git:status: git status && echo '---' && cd api-ventago && git status && echo '---' && cd ../ventago-app && git status
scripts.git:push:all: npm run git:push:root && npm run git:push:api && npm run git:push:app
scripts.git:push:root: git add . && git commit -m "chore: 모노레포 통합 업데이트" || echo 'No changes in root' && git push
scripts.git:push:api: cd api-ventago && git add . && git commit -m "chore: 모노레포에서 업데이트" || echo 'No changes in api-ventago' && git push && cd ..
scripts.git:push:app: cd ventago-app && git add . && git commit -m "chore: 모노레포에서 업데이트" || echo 'No changes in ventago-app' && git push && cd ..
scripts.git:commit:all: npm run git:commit:root && npm run git:commit:api && npm run git:commit:app
scripts.git:commit:root: git add . && git commit -m "chore: 모노레포 통합 업데이트" || echo 'No changes in root'
scripts.git:commit:api: cd api-ventago && git add . && git commit -m "chore: 모노레포에서 업데이트" || echo 'No changes in api-ventago' && cd ..
scripts.git:commit:app: cd ventago-app && git add . && git commit -m "chore: 모노레포에서 업데이트" || echo 'No changes in ventago-app' && cd ..
scripts.db:create: createdb ventago || echo 'Database already exists or createdb not found'
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:create && npm run db:migrate
